notes: The prenominal possessor *the Lord's* puts the determiner on the inner article and empties the outer one (rules 20, 57).
Splitting ἄχρι οὗ so that the relative is unrepresented remains defensible; the single English word *till* is what joins them under rule 39's test, as rule 50 reads `ἕως ἄν` → *till*.
A reference comparison will report the unrepresented ἐάν as a disagreement; rule 72 licenses it.
